items.name: archify
items.title: Archify
items.description: Validated interactive system maps and diagrams as standalone HTML from a typed JSON spec, for one of five diagram types (architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle). Use when the user asks to visualize architecture, a workflow, a call sequence, a data pipeline, or a state machine, or to map this repository. Not for ad hoc drawings or slide art, and not for Mermaid output; use the artifact tool for plain Markdown.

items.name: architecture
items.title: Architecture
items.description: Decides the engineering approach for an intent in an interactive session: investigates, proposes two or three genuinely different approaches with trade-offs, recommends, lets the user decide, and writes the decision doc. Not a task-by-task plan; use cut-it. Not a multi-perspective debate; use design-council. Not product intent; use product-intent. Not a typed implementation handoff; use tech-spec.

items.name: arxiv-literature
items.title: arXiv Literature
items.description: Searches arXiv, summarizes or compares papers, and builds a compact literature survey as citation-ready, source-linked paper cards. Prefer the Researcher shadow agent for noisy multi-paper retrieval.

items.name: ast-grep
items.title: Ast Grep
items.description: Structural code search with ast-grep rules: finds code by shape when grep on text is too noisy, and never rewrites it. Not for plain string or filename lookups; use grep or find.

items.name: backlog
items.title: Backlog
items.description: Turns a finished PRD or architecture doc into a ticket backlog of small stories with verifiable acceptance criteria, confirmed, then created as GitHub issues or in another configured tracker. Not for local sprint slicing into a SPRINT.md; use cut-it.

items.name: branch-closeout
items.title: Branch Closeout
items.description: Proves merged work on the canonical base, inspects and removes associated worktrees through Git, deletes local branches safely, and audits surviving repository refs. Not for creating worktrees; use worktree-create. Not for integrating branches; use worktree-merge.

items.name: clio-agents
items.title: Agents
items.description: Scientific workflow planning and independent evidence review agents.

items.name: clio-analysis-skills
items.title: Analysis Skills
items.description: Skills for the clio-analysis workflow: turn a dataset into summary statistics and a figure.

items.name: clio-coder-dev
items.title: Coder Dev
items.description: Governs changes to Clio Coder's own source and harness (TUI, skills, agents, tools, prompts, domains): what may change freely, what needs explicit user intent, and how to change it without breaking the architecture. Not for verifying a change against the harness; use clio-coder-test.

items.name: clio-coder-skills
items.title: Clio Coder skills

items.name: clio-coder-test
items.title: Coder Test
items.description: Verifies a Clio Coder source change against the current contract, smoke, boundary, and application test lanes, including temporary-state and local-provider harnesses. Not for deciding what may change; use clio-coder-dev.

items.name: clio-geoscience-skills
items.title: Geoscience Skills

items.name: clio-hpc-skills
items.title: HPC Skills
items.description: Skills for the clio-hpc workflow: install a code, wrap it in a pipeline, submit it, and follow it on a cluster.

items.name: clio-performance-skills
items.title: Performance Skills
items.description: Skills for the clio-performance workflow: work out why a finished job was slower than it should have been.

items.name: clio-research-skills
items.title: Research Skills
items.description: Skills for the clio-research workflow: find papers on a topic and the datasets behind them.

items.name: clio-scientific-io-skills
items.title: Scientific I/O Skills
items.description: Skills for the clio-scientific-io workflow: open a scientific data file, see its structure, and read part of it.

items.name: clio-skills
items.title: Skills
items.description: Skills for the six primary scientific workflows, without MCP servers.

items.name: coding-standards
items.title: Coding Standards
items.description: Correct-by-construction TypeScript rules (errors as values, parse don't validate, illegal states unrepresentable, deep modules) for writing or refactoring TypeScript when the project has not pinned its own standards.

items.name: context-handoff
items.title: Context Handoff
items.description: Writes a durable, redacted, reference-not-copy handoff document when a session winds down or context is about to be compacted or lost, so the next session or agent can continue. Not for orienting at the start of a session; use context-prime.

items.name: context-prime
items.title: Context Prime
items.description: Orients a fresh session in a repository by loading the last handoff, git state, the project constitution, and active-work signals before acting. Not for writing the handoff; use context-handoff.

items.name: credentials
items.title: Credentials
items.description: Handles API keys, tokens, and facility credentials (kerberos tickets, globus and scheduler tokens, ssh agents, netrc) before a tool needs one, after an auth error, when a new secret is supplied, or when one may have leaked. Not for provider target configuration; use clio-coder auth and target settings.

items.name: cut-it
items.title: Cut It
items.description: Slices an existing plan, PRD, or milestone into an executable sprint of dependency-ordered vertical slices sized for one agent run each, with done-when verification per slice; never fabricates a plan. Not for deciding the approach; use architecture.

items.name: design-council
items.title: Design Council
items.description: Convenes several expert perspectives that challenge each other on a design decision with real trade-offs before code is written; quick mode runs a single round. Not for a one-question-at-a-time interrogation of a plan; use grill-me. Not for splitting implementation across workers; use dispatch directly.

items.name: experiment-protocol
items.title: Experiment Protocol
items.description: Pre-registers a performance study, numerical comparison, parameter sweep, or benchmark: thresholds, tolerances, environment pins, and verdict conditions locked into the validation contract before any measurement. Not for diagnosing a stalled bug; use scientific-debugging.

items.name: file-ticket
items.title: File Ticket
items.description: Turns something noticed mid-session into a tracker issue: captures evidence, dedups against existing issues, composes a labeled issue with acceptance criteria, confirms, and creates it via gh. Not for batch ticket creation from a PRD; use backlog. Not for diagnosing an existing issue; use fix-issue.

items.name: find-skills
items.title: Find Skills
items.description: Finds published skills and prepares their Library installation for the operator when the user asks whether a capability exists as a skill. Not for authoring a new skill; use skill-craft.

items.name: fix-issue
items.title: Fix Issue
items.description: Resolves a tracker issue end to end: fetches it, diagnoses only when the issue does not name the code, fixes test-first, and self-reviews against the acceptance criteria, leaving a verified uncommitted change. Not for filing; use file-ticket. Not for committing or PRs; use ship.

items.name: grill-me
items.title: Grill Me
items.description: Stress-tests a plan, design, or idea through a phased one-question-at-a-time interview before code is written, ending in a compact decision log. Not for a multi-perspective debate; use design-council.

items.name: herdr
items.title: Herdr
items.description: Launches, drives, or inspects another agent or command in a Herdr pane, tab, or workspace, including a second Clio Coder instance; requires HERDR_ENV=1. Not for background work a plain shell or dispatch already covers.

items.name: materio
items.title: Materio
items.description: Materio: materials research interviews, supplied-corpus synthesis, lab feasibility, task execution and verified paper handoff.

items.name: prd
items.title: Prd
items.description: Turns an idea into a product requirements document through a phase-gated interview, ending in PRD.md plus per-milestone prompt files ready to drive a coding agent. Not for the problem-first product thesis; use product-intent.

items.name: product-intent
items.title: Product Intent
items.description: Writes a problem-first product document for a greenfield effort: interviews for the problem, evidence, and a falsifiable hypothesis, with zero engineering decisions. Not for engineering decisions; use architecture. Not for turning a locked idea into milestone build prompts; use prd.

items.name: prototype
items.title: Prototype
items.description: Answers a design question with throwaway code: a clearly marked, runnable, no-persistence prototype whose verdict is kept and whose code is discarded. Not for pre-registered performance experiments; use experiment-protocol. Not for production implementation.

items.name: resolve-merge-conflicts
items.title: Resolve Merge Conflicts
items.description: Resolves a merge, rebase, or cherry-pick stopped on conflicts by reconstructing both sides' intent, validating with the project's own checks, and completing the operation. Not for integrating many branches; use worktree-merge.

items.name: scientific-debugging
items.title: Scientific Debugging
items.description: Diagnoses stalled or cross-system failures and wrong, NaN, nondeterministic, or unexpectedly slow scientific results through falsifiable hypotheses across distinct fault classes, with evidence-cited verdicts before any fix. Not for designing benchmarks or pre-registered experiments; use experiment-protocol.

items.name: scientific-modernization
items.title: Scientific Modernization
items.description: Modernizes, ports, rewrites, packages, or replaces established scientific software in independently validated stages against an external scientific oracle, settling compatibility and upstream stewardship before calling it complete. Not for an isolated benchmark; use experiment-protocol. Not for diagnosing wrong results; use scientific-debugging.

items.name: ship
items.title: Ship
items.description: Ships finished work: writes one reviewed atomic commit, keeps maintainer branches local, or pushes a contributor branch to their fork and opens a PR only on explicit intent. Not for producing the change; use fix-issue.

items.name: skill-craft
items.title: Skill Craft
items.description: Writes, reviews, or prunes a SKILL.md, judging whether its description, body, and length earn their cost. Not for packaging a workflow that just happened; use workflow-distiller.

items.name: tdd
items.title: TDD
items.description: Builds a feature or fix test-first, red to green at pre-agreed public seams, one vertical slice at a time. Not for designing benchmark criteria; use experiment-protocol.

items.name: tech-spec
items.title: Tech Spec
items.description: Writes a typed call-stack architecture handoff: code-shaped contracts plus execution flows, implementation-ready for another engineer. User-invoked only. Not for weighing approaches or deciding the design; use architecture first.

items.name: workflow-distiller
items.title: Workflow Distiller
items.description: Packages a workflow that just happened into a reusable SKILL.md: reconstructs it from the session record, checks overlap with installed skills, gates on approval, then writes it following skill-craft. Not for authoring a skill with no prior workflow; use skill-craft.

items.name: worktree-create
items.title: Worktree Create
items.description: Stands up one or more git worktrees for parallel work, each on its own branch with gitignored config copied in, dependencies installed, and a verified health check. Not for merging finished worktrees; use worktree-merge. Not for closeout; use branch-closeout.

items.name: worktree-merge
items.title: Worktree Merge
items.description: Integrates finished worktree branches through one throwaway integration branch, testing after each merge and running the full suite before the main line moves, with exact rollback on failure. Not for creating worktrees; use worktree-create. Not for closeout; use branch-closeout.

items.title: Skill Craft
items.description: Use when this workflow is requested: Writes, reviews, or prunes a SKILL.md, judging whether its description, body, and length earn their cost. Not for packaging a workflow that just happened; use workflow-distiller. Triggers on "write a SKILL.md", "create a new skill".

items.name: clio-kit-tdd
items.title: Test-Driven Development
items.description: Use when this workflow is requested: Builds a feature or fix test-first, red to green at pre-agreed public seams, one vertical slice at a time. Not for designing benchmark criteria; use experiment-protocol. Triggers on "test-driven development", "write the test first".

items.name: clio-kit-tech-spec
items.title: Tech Spec
items.description: Use when this workflow is requested: Writes a typed call-stack architecture handoff: code-shaped contracts plus execution flows, implementation-ready for another engineer. User-invoked only. Not for weighing approaches or deciding the design; use architecture first. Triggers on "write a tech spec", "typed call-stack handoff".

items.name: clio-kit-workflow-distiller
items.title: Workflow Distiller
items.description: Use when this workflow is requested: Packages a workflow that just happened into a reusable SKILL.md: reconstructs it from the session record, checks overlap with installed skills, gates on approval, then writes it following skill-craft. Not for authoring a skill with no prior workflow; use skill-craft. Triggers on "make this workflow a skill", "package what we just did".

items.name: clio-kit-worktree-create
items.title: Worktree Create
items.description: Use when this workflow is requested: Stands up one or more git worktrees for parallel work, each on its own branch with gitignored config copied in, dependencies installed, and a verified health check. Not for merging finished worktrees; use worktree-merge. Not for closeout; use branch-closeout. Triggers on "create a git worktree", "set up worktrees for these branches".

items.name: clio-kit-worktree-merge
items.title: Worktree Merge
items.description: Use when this workflow is requested: Integrates finished worktree branches through one throwaway integration branch, testing after each merge and running the full suite before the main line moves, with exact rollback on failure. Not for creating worktrees; use worktree-create. Not for closeout; use branch-closeout. Triggers on "merge my worktrees", "integrate these worktree branches".

items.name: creating-dataset-report
items.title: Create a verified dataset report
items.description: Use when creating a report from a small numeric HDF5 dataset with a CSV, statistics and figure. Triggers on "dataset report", "inspect summarize and plot". Not for large-file streaming or model fitting.

items.name: diagnosing-a-slow-job
items.title: Diagnose Scientific I/O Performance
items.description: Use when investigating I/O bottlenecks using a genuine Darshan profile and application logs. Triggers on "Darshan log", "why was this job slow", "I/O bottleneck". Not for metric interpretation alone; use interpreting-io-performance-numbers.

items.name: exploring-an-unfamiliar-dataset
items.title: Inspect Scientific Dataset Structure
items.description: Use when inspecting structure, shapes, types and units in HDF5, BP5, Parquet or compressed files. Triggers on "what is in this file", "open this dataset", "inspect this HDF5". Not for large-data reductions; use reading-large-datasets-safely.

items.name: finding-and-staging-a-dataset
items.title: Discover and Stage Research Datasets
items.description: Use when finding dataset metadata and downloading a supported resource to a verified local path. Triggers on "find a dataset", "download this data", "stage this resource". Not for literature surveys; use surveying-literature-and-datasets.

items.name: interpreting-io-performance-numbers
items.title: Interpret I/O Performance Metrics
items.description: Use when interpreting bandwidth, IOPS, request sizes and MPI-IO counters already provided. Triggers on "is 40 MB/s bad", "small writes", "collective versus independent". Calls no tools. Not for loading a profile; use diagnosing-a-slow-job.

items.name: managing-software-environments
items.title: Discover and Verify HPC Software Environments
items.description: Use when checking installed Spack packages and available or saved module environments. Triggers on "module avail", "which MPI", "is this installed". Not for executing a workload; use running-a-simulation-on-a-cluster.

items.name: mapping-geospatial-and-terrain-data
items.title: Validate and Map Geospatial Data
items.description: Use when validating GeoJSON, querying spatial relationships, mapping features or analyzing terrain grids. Triggers on "GeoJSON", "render a map", "DEM", "point cloud". Not for CRS interpretation alone; use working-with-coordinate-systems.

items.name: reading-large-datasets-safely
items.title: Read and Summarize Large Scientific Datasets
items.description: Use when choosing bounded reads and distinguishing sampled summaries from exact large-data statistics. Triggers on "file is huge", "compute this mean", "out of memory". Not for initial format discovery; use exploring-an-unfamiliar-dataset.

items.name: recording-a-session-for-provenance
items.title: Record and Retrieve Research Session Provenance
items.description: Use when explicitly recording or retrieving a research decision trail with ChronoLog. Triggers on "record this session", "ChronoLog", "retrieve our decisions". Not for job execution profiling; use diagnosing-a-slow-job.

items.name: running-a-simulation-on-a-cluster
items.title: Execute and Monitor a Cluster Simulation
items.description: Use when resolving Spack software, configuring a JARVIS pipeline and following its execution. Triggers on "run this on the cluster", "JARVIS pipeline", "install and run". Not for handwritten batch scripts; use writing-slurm-job-scripts.

items.name: searching-large-log-files
items.title: Investigate Large Application Logs
items.description: Use when narrowing large application logs by timestamp, level, keyword or error pattern. Triggers on "find the error", "search this log", "what happened at". Not for Darshan profiles; use diagnosing-a-slow-job.

items.name: summarizing-and-plotting-results
items.title: Summarize and Plot Scientific Results
items.description: Use when calculating tabular summaries and plotting transformed CSV or Excel data. Triggers on "summarize this table", "plot these results", "grouped mean". Not for mesh or volume rendering; use visualizing-3d-simulation-output.

items.name: surveying-literature-and-datasets
items.title: Survey Research Literature and Associated Data
items.description: Use when searching prior work and identifying datasets associated with research claims. Triggers on "find papers on", "literature survey", "prior work". Not for formatting a known citation list; use building-a-bibliography.

items.name: visualizing-3d-simulation-output
items.title: Visualize Three-Dimensional Simulation Output
items.description: Use when inspecting and rendering simulation fields with ParaView. Triggers on "isosurface", "slice this volume", "render the field". Not for tabular charts; use summarizing-and-plotting-results.

items.name: working-with-coordinate-systems
items.title: Interpret Coordinate Reference Systems
items.description: Use when interpreting axis order, projections, distance units or vertical datums. Triggers on "lat lon", "CRS", "UTM", "map offset". Calls no tools. Not for executing map operations; use mapping-geospatial-and-terrain-data.

items.name: writing-slurm-job-scripts
items.title: Prepare and Diagnose Slurm Job Scripts
items.description: Use when preparing Slurm resource requests, arrays and dependencies or diagnosing pending jobs. Triggers on "sbatch", "job array", "why is my job pending". Not for JARVIS execution; use running-a-simulation-on-a-cluster.

items.name: clio-analysis
items.title: From results to insight
items.description: Turn a dataset into summary statistics and a figure.
items.outcome: Summary statistics, clear figures and guidance for interpreting them.

items.name: clio-dataset-report
items.title: Dataset Report
items.description: Turn a small HDF5 dataset into a report with a CSV, figure, checked statistics and evidence review.

items.name: clio-geoscience
items.title: Explore the physical world
items.description: Inspect and map geospatial features, terrain models, and waveform archives.
items.outcome: Workflows for geographic features, terrain and seismic data.

items.name: clio-hpc
items.title: Run work on a cluster
items.description: Install a code, wrap it in a pipeline, submit it, and follow it on a cluster.
items.outcome: A resource-aware path from software setup to workload monitoring.

items.name: clio-performance
items.title: Understand a slow job
items.description: Work out why a finished job was slower than it should have been.
items.outcome: An investigation of I/O behavior, logs and potential bottlenecks.

items.name: clio-research
items.title: Find the research behind it
items.description: Find papers on a topic and the datasets behind them.
items.outcome: Papers and datasets, with guidance for discovery and staging.

items.name: clio-scientific-io
items.title: Explore a scientific dataset
items.description: Open a scientific data file, see its structure, and read part of it.
items.outcome: A bounded view of your data, its structure and storage choices.
